_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-36 base rate on ±2-point moves over 12h windows is the dominant statistical fact — both brains see the accumulation analog but neither has a confirmed breaker, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until etf_flows or btc_momentum_30d actually triggers.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — both agree on the Denial phase and the bottom analog, but the analyst calls direction UP (low conviction) while the base-rate data and my trust-weighted reconciliation favor HOLD; the narrative writer does not explicitly commit to a forward direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustains above 100 AND btc_momentum_30d breaks above 55 AND mvrv_zscore climbs above 28 — this would shift the call from HOLD to LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 80 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d dropping sharply (distribution) OR fed_liquidity remains pinned at 0 while funding turns negative — this would break the coil downward toward Panic
